title: A Inheritance for the Will
author: B. M. Delacroix
blurb: Vesper Underhill, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
